title: Timbaland Introduces New AI Artist (Rolling Stone)
notes: Rolling Stone (top-tier), Brian Hiatt, 2025-06-05. Stage Zero launched June 2025 by Timbaland + Zayd Portillo + Rocky Mudaliar; first AI artist TaTa; music via Suno with human-written lyrics; Timbaland is a Suno creative adviser; Stage Zero independent of Suno; 'A-pop' genre coined.
